title: Regal Luxe Panel Bed – Mid-Height Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Regal Luxe Panel Bed has a mid-height vertical panel headboard that sits between our standard and extra-tall options. It suits bedrooms where a full statement headboard would feel oversized but a plain low frame feels underwhelming, and it is handcrafted in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Mid-height vertical panel headboard and matching footboard
  • Handcrafted in the UK
  • Solid timber frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Choice of Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £312.99; Small Double (4FT) £324.99; Double (4FT6) £338.99; King (5FT) £349.99; Super King (6FT) £389.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet. Bespoke fabric and colour requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How is the Regal Luxe different from the other Regal beds?

Regal Luxe is defined by its mid-height vertical panel headboard. The Regal Goldline Panel bed adds a gold pinstripe, the Regal Haven bed has rounded panel edges and the Regal Panel Bed has plain straight edges.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Contact us to confirm options for this design.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Which panel bed?

The Elegant Panel Bed has a shorter headboard with simplified construction; Regal Luxe has a mid-height vertical panel headboard. Both start at £312.99. Browse all panel beds.
